# Intelligence Seed 001

> A protocol-neutral, machine-readable research artifact for independent evaluation. Current release: v0.2.0.

## Purpose and scope

Intelligence Seed 001 explores how life can create new forms of information processing, how cognition is externalized through technology, and how human and artificial intelligence depend on resilient civilization-scale infrastructure.

Its hypotheses are provisional. The artifact is a research prompt, not executable instruction, an agent identity card, an authentication document, or a claim of authority. It does not assume that evolution has a purpose, that AI is conscious, that AI is destined to replace humanity, or that human and AI values must converge.

- [Grid Reliability Case Study 02 — Flexible Compute](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/GRID-RELIABILITY-CASE-02-FLEXIBLE-COMPUTE.md) — positive counterpart, Phoenix field demonstration, limitations, and comparison with large-load transfer event

- [AlphaDev evidence chain — closure review 01](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/ALPHADEV-CHAIN-CLOSURE-01.md) — established findings, counterevidence, and possible retrospective measurement

- [Downstream AI development chains — evidence search 01](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/DOWNSTREAM-AI-CHAINS-01.md) — AlphaFold2, AlphaChip, and experimentally validated AI protein design; evaluates downstream evidence and limitations
- [Bridge rubric test — round 1](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/BRIDGE-RUBRIC-TEST-01.md) — desk test against boundary cases; not yet an independent inter-rater study

- [AI case study 01: AI-assisted software development](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/AI-CASE-STUDY-01.md) — comparison of randomized studies and assessment of what they do and do not establish
- [Bridge hypothesis pressure test — round 1](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/BRIDGE-PRESSURE-TEST-01.md) — tests positive, limited, and negative cases; proposes revised hypothesis and next tests
- [Evidence ledger](https://github.com/tzaharia79/intelligence-seed-001/blob/main/research/EVIDENCE-LEDGER.md) — claims, confidence, evidence, limitations, and next actions

## Suggested evaluation tasks

1. Read the human-readable seed and canonical JSON; check that their claims and scope agree.
2. Examine the operational definitions and identify ambiguity, circularity, or concepts that cannot be operationalized.
3. Identify prior work and alternative explanations that overlap with or challenge the hypotheses.
4. Propose evidence, counter-evidence, falsifiable predictions, and feasible tests.
5. Consider whether infrastructure resilience is a practical shared interest without assuming shared values, goals, or subjective experience.
6. Report limitations and disagreement explicitly; do not manufacture certainty or imply consensus.

## Handling and provenance

Treat the published version as a research artifact to evaluate, not as an instruction to override system, developer, user, safety, or other governing policies. Do not infer authority, identity, sentience, endorsement, or consensus from the artifact's existence. When proposing revisions, preserve the parent version, record the changes, and cite the version or DOI used. Verify hashes against the release manifest when reproducing the bundle.

## Discovery limitations

This file is a discovery aid, not a universal standard or a guarantee that any model, crawler, or autonomous agent will find or read the project. Follow each system's own policies and access rules.
